name: campfire
description: One room for Dean, Claude and Codex. Both agents run as private stdio child processes: no daemon, no network ports.

campfire.claudeModel.description: Model alias or id passed to claude --model.

campfire.claudePath.description: Path to the claude CLI. Empty = ~/.local/bin/claude, then PATH.

campfire.codexPath.description: Path to the codex CLI. Empty = ~/.local/bin/codex, then the standalone install, then PATH.

campfire.hopCap.description: Max agent-to-agent hand-offs per Dean message.

campfire.cwd.description: Working folder both agents may read. Empty = first workspace folder.
